svg.title: Example: Team Onboarding
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape board: before day one checklist, a first-week plan, people to meet, how we work here, a buddy, and 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins.
svg.text: Help a new team member feel welcome, get set up and do useful work quickly, with a buddy and clear check-ins.
Set Up the Team · Onboarding · First Week · 30 / 60 / 90 Days
SO DAY ONE ISN'T ABOUT WAITING
Added to channels, calendars and boards
Team told who's joining and when
ONE STEP A DAY · A PLAN, NOT A FIREHOSE
“What do you wish someone had told you in your first week?”
“What could the newest person see that we've stopped noticing?”
Agile Lifecycle · Plan · Build · Review · Improve
